summary.title: Fast mode and model reasoning settings
changes: A new "Use Fast mode" toggle prefers faster AI responses when available.
Fast mode may cost more and will fall back to standard processing if fast capacity is unavailable.
Each configured food-analysis model now includes a "Reasoning effort" picker to set analysis depth.
Higher reasoning effort can increase response time and cost.
Saved effort choices stay with each model, update from the catalog, and revert to the model default if unsupported.
